validated_results.title: Garlic-derived S-allylmercaptocysteine is a novel in vivo antimetastatic agent for androgen-independent prostate cancer.
validated_results.journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
validated_results.reason: This is a preclinical in vivo mouse xenograft/orthotopic model study of S-allylmercaptocysteine with no human incidence data.

validated_results.title: Genistein chemoprevention of prostate cancer in TRAMP mice.
validated_results.reason: Genistein chemoprevention was evaluated exclusively in TRAMP and C57BL/6 mice, not in humans.

validated_results.title: Clinical relevance of the inhibitory effect of green tea catechins (GtCs) on prostate cancer progression in combination with molecular profiling of catechin-resistant tumors: an integrated view.
validated_results.reason: The article is a narrative "integrated view" summarizing prior laboratory, animal, and pilot trial findings rather than reporting an original human study.

validated_results.title: Clinical relevance of the inhibitory effect of green tea catechins (GtCs) on prostate cancer progression in combination with molecular profiling of catechin-resistant tumors: an integrated view.
validated_results.reason: The publication is a narrative review integrating previously reported green tea catechin and molecular profiling results without new primary human incidence analysis.

validated_results.title: A prospective study of plasma vitamin D metabolites, vitamin D receptor polymorphisms, and prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: The report centers on a genotype-stratified or gene-exposure interaction, which this protocol excludes.

validated_results.title: Selenium and prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: The record supplies only a title with no abstract and appears to be a non-primary commentary/overview on selenium rather than an original study.
